notes: Duplicates: 'Example folder…' copies the sets Breezy is least sure about into a folder to look at (Breezy Output > Duplicate examples). In each set the file it would keep is marked KEEP, the others 'extra'. On the way every byte of the copies is compared, and a note in each set says whether they are truly identical. The originals are not touched.

Duplicates: how sure is 'sure'? Same-footage sets by how alike the pictures are; identical files by how much of the file the quick check compared (size plus three 1 MB samples - the whole file up to 3 MB, less of it the bigger the file).

Duplicates: with 'Also find the same footage' off, a scan no longer opens every video - it only needs each file's size, date and quick check. 85,000 videos are listed in a minute or two instead of 40 minutes. (Picture size and length stay empty in that list; Compare still works.)

Enhance: AI denoise and AI deblur can now use TensorRT. It couldn't prepare them for 'any tile size'; now it prepares one engine for each tile size actually used, checks its result against the processor's, and falls back to CUDA for a size where that doesn't work (remembered). Settings > AI > 'Prepare AI denoise and AI deblur for TensorRT now' does it ahead of time and shows which engine each one runs with and how fast.
Tasks: a task's own summary is kept when it finished with problems ('… · 1 problem(s)').
